content: Muitsexi mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe 'Ixaheri nuiwarieyatsie memanuyetei: «Yawé mɨpaɨ kanaineni kename
kepauka 'uki Yawé hetsiemieme muyuhɨritɨa tixaɨtɨ mɨtiyetuanikɨ, yarehɨawetɨ kename yatikayani, mɨkɨ pɨkatiku'itawani matsi keheye'atɨani kemutayɨ.
»Kepauka 'uka 'ɨimari, yupaapa kie 'ukaitɨ 'akuxi Yawé hetsɨa muyuhɨritɨa yamɨtikayanikɨ,
xɨka paapaya retimaime 'atsikatitahɨawe, mɨkɨ kemɨtiyuhɨritɨakai naime katinaye'atɨamɨkɨ.
Peru xɨka paapaya retimaimetɨtɨ yakatiutanaki'erieni kemɨtiyuhɨritɨakai yamɨtikayanikɨ, naimekɨ kemutayɨkai tixaɨtɨ pɨkarayani, Yawé katineiyehɨwiriemɨkɨ paapaya yamɨkatiutanaki'erikɨ.
xɨka kɨnaya retimani peru xɨka 'atsikatitahɨawe ka'itatieni, mɨkɨ kaneye'atɨamɨkɨ kemɨtiyuhɨritɨa.
Peru xɨka kɨnaya retimaime yakatiutanaki'erieni, mɨkɨ kemɨtiuyuhɨritɨakai tixaɨtɨ pɨkarayani Yawé katineiyehɨwiriemɨkɨ.
xɨka kɨnaya retimaime 'atsikatitahɨawe ka'itatieni, mɨkɨ kaneye'atɨamɨkɨ naime kemɨtiuyuhɨritɨa.
Peru xɨka kɨnaya retimaime 'ita'imaiya, hikɨ mɨkɨ pɨkayɨwe meye'atɨanikɨ xeimetɨma kemɨtiuyuhɨritɨa, kɨnaya yamɨkatiutanaki'erikɨ. Yawé katineiyehɨwiriemɨkɨ.
»Kɨnaya heitserie kaneixeiyani yamɨtayɨnikɨ yatɨni yamɨkatitanaki'erienikɨ titakɨ mɨtiyuhɨritɨakai Yawé hetsɨa.
Xɨkata kɨnaya retimaimetɨtɨ kayuwatɨ 'uyeikani, 'atsimɨkahainekɨ kani'inɨaritɨni kename yara'eriwa kemɨtiuyuhɨritɨa. Kunaya yara'eriwatɨ kaniyɨanemɨkɨ 'atsimɨka'utayɨkɨ kepauka mɨretima.
Xɨkata retimaimetɨtɨ 'arikeketa 'uta'imani, mɨkɨ hetsiena katinahuimɨkɨ yɨ'ɨya hetsiemieme».
'Ikɨ 'aitsika Yawé Muitsexi kaniyetuirieni, kememɨ'anenikekai yɨkɨnamatɨ yɨ'ɨitatɨ kememɨ'anenikekai meta 'uki 'uka munuarie kememɨ'anenikekai mexi hetsɨana 'ukani.
